high_level_description: This image showcases a cozy and stylish living room setup featuring a set of brown leather sofas with tufted upholstery. The room has a rustic yet modern aesthetic, highlighted by the exposed brick wall on one side, which adds a touch of industrial charm. The floor is covered with light-colored wooden planks, complementing the warm tones of the furniture. The seating arrangement includes two large sofas placed back-to-back, creating an inviting conversation area.
